title.en: An Act to Grant An Extension of thirty Days to the Tayabas Light and Power Company, Incorporated, to Comply With the Requirements of Act Numbered thirty-Six Hundred and Forty-Nine Granting the Said Company a Franchise for Electric Light, Heat and Power, in Tayabas, Province of Tayabas.

text.en:
The Tayabas Light and Power Company is granted an extension of thirty days, from the date of
the approval of this Act, to comply with the terms and conditions set forth in Act Numbered Thirty-six
hundred and forty-nine relative to the acceptance of the franchise, the deposit and other requirements under
the said Act granting the Tayabas Light and Power Company, Incorporated, a franchise to install and operate
an electric plant in the municipality of Tayabas, Province of Tayabas: Provided, however, That the said
franchise shall be subject to the limitations provided in the Constitution of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 29, 1936.
